title: Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy: My wife is doing great, she gave me her blessing to return

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy: My wife is doing great, she gave me her blessing to return
sources.description: Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy returned to the team last week after leaving the team to be with his wife Mia as she recovered from being shot in late July and he spoke to reporters for the first time since getting back on Tuesday.
